description: Typesets markdown as a PDF or DOCX on the firm's letterhead and files it in the matter's Dropbox folder. Does not overwrite. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

file_name.description: Optional file name without extension. Fails if a file with that name already exists.

format.description: pdf (default) or docx for an editable copy.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

markdown.description: Document body as markdown: headings, lists, bold/italic, quotes.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

subfolder.description: Optional existing folder inside the matter folder.

title.description: Document title, printed under the letterhead. Also the file name unless file_name is given.

name: create_matter_document
title: Create document on letterhead
